fusions.name: Tethered Toss
fusions.desc: A light throw on a braided line that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristle Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 4 needle-thin points in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. You hold up to 3 flights, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Strand Snare
fusions.desc: Strings a web of strands 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Braided Grip
fusions.desc: Conjures a braided grip wrap: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, your attack speed rises by 5%, and each kill returns 2 health.
